10k.note: 10-K Item 1 confirms Fortrea is a contract research organization (CRO) providing Phase I-IV clinical trial management, clinical pharmacology, and consulting services to biopharma and medtech customers. One reporting segment: Clinical Services. No proprietary drug or device assets owned by the company.

website.error: No corporate pipeline page exists for a CRO; Fortrea.com lists service offerings only.

ctgov.note: Sponsor query returns 0 P1-3 trials lead-sponsored by Fortrea. Hits associated with Fortrea (Italfarmaco, Innovent, Vifor, D3 Bio, Anbogen, Alebund, LeonaBio) are client-sponsored studies where Fortrea provides services; per workflow rules these are excluded from a CRO's pipeline.

excluded_partner_owned: All trials in which Fortrea appears in ClinicalTrials.gov are client-sponsored (Italfarmaco, Innovent Biologics, Vifor International, D3 Bio, Anbogen Therapeutics, Alebund Pharmaceuticals, LeonaBio); Fortrea acts as CRO service provider, not as asset owner.
no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Services / CRO company - no proprietary clinical pipeline. Fortrea Holdings (spun off from Labcorp on 2023-06-29) is a global contract research organization providing Phase I-IV trial management, clinical pharmacology (CRUs in Leeds, Dallas, Daytona, Madison), and consulting services to pharmaceutical, biotechnology and medical device customers across ~100 countries. Single reporting segment (Clinical Services). The company does not own or develop drug or device assets.
